_readme: Fill legalName and address before going live. If 34 Automation is a limited company, also fill companyNumber (and registeredIn if not England and Wales). Leave companyNumber empty if it isn't a company. The production build refuses to deploy while legalName or address is empty.
_reviews: reviewsSummary: false (Edie HOLD, 11 Nov). true would show the review count and average above published reviews when there is at least one. Published reviews live in public/reviews.json.
_news: News (content/news/README.md). There is no on/off switch: News turns on by itself when content/news/ holds at least one approved post, and stays off (no header or footer link, no /news/, no home teaser, nothing in the sitemap) while it holds none. newsMode: "archive" builds every approved post and lists them at /news/; "replace" builds only the newest, 301s each older slug to /news/ and leaves it out of the sitemap. newsIndexIntro: the line under the News heading at /news/ (left out while empty). newsIndexDescription: the meta description of /news/ (the newest post's standfirst while empty). newsCloser: the closing line at the end of each post, linked to /#contact (left out while empty). The three copy lines need approved copy from Maya or Scott.
